label: Opening Hook
text: Thousands of years ago, people cut holes in living patients' skulls, and many of those patients survived.
title: File:Parts of instrument for trepanning of the skull. Wellcome L0016674.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Trepanation is among the oldest known surgical procedures, with Neolithic examples thousands of years old Healed bone around many openings shows patients lived for months or years afterwards Found across Europe, Peru and elsewhere Studies of ancient Peruvian skulls suggest survival rates improved over centuries Reasons may have included treating head injuries; ritual motives are debated
title: File:Diorama showing trephination in Neolithic times, England, 19 Wellcome L0058021.jpg
